decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, along with powerful equipment like Embercleave, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Jaspera Sentinel helps generate additional resources and value, allowing the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Shatterskull Smashing and The Akroan War to deal with threats, while also having flexible land options to ensure consistency in mana production.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful threats. It utilizes its companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of versatile cards, such as Cultivate and Emergent Ultimatum, to ensure it can adapt to different situations. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to grind out incremental advantages until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly playing powerful creatures and using them to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. It uses cards like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Embercleave to create aggressive board presence and finish off the opponent with cards like Goldspan Dragon and Shatterskull Smashing. The key strategy is to consistently apply pressure to the opponent while using the versatility of the creatures and the ability to ramp up mana using cards like Edgewall Innkeeper to maintain advantage and control the game.

This control deck focuses on utilizing powerful removal spells to control the board state, while also generating card advantage through the use of Yorion, Sky Nomad and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck includes a variety of threats to pressure the opponent, such as Elder Gargaroth and Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider, while also incorporating disruptive spells like Jwari Disruption and Power Word Kill to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with its versatile cards and win the game through incremental advantage and powerful late-game plays.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence using aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Goldspan Dragon, the deck aims to apply early pressure on the opponent and maintain tempo throughout the game. Additionally, cards like The Great Henge and Lovestruck Beast provide additional value and resilience against removal. The inclusion of Embercleave and Shatterskull Smashing helps to close out games quickly and efficiently, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive strategy.

The focus of this deck is control through a combination of powerful removal spells, counterspells, and board wipes. With a mix of versatile threats and powerful spells, the deck can outvalue opponents and control the game until it can eventually win through a powerful combo or overwhelming advantage. The deck focuses on building a board presence quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Winota, Joiner of Forces and Elite Spellbinder to generate powerful attacking creatures. By playing aggressive creatures like Blade Historian and Minsc, Beloved Ranger, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a high tempo strategy. Cards like Lotus Cobra and Jaspera Sentinel help ramp up mana and provide additional support for the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly amass a threatening board state and apply pressure on the opponent to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board with a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and sweepers. It also generates advantage through card draw and mana ramp in order to stabilize and eventually win the game with powerful threats like Iymrith, Desert Doom and Shark Typhoon. The deck has a strong late-game plan with cards like Midnight Clock and You Find the Villains' Lair to outvalue the opponent. It plays a reactive game, biding time until it can establish dominance and close out the game efficiently.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of mill, removal spells, and countering key spells. By utilizing cards like Ruin Crab and Thieves' Guild Enforcer to mill the opponent's deck, Soaring Thought-Thief to enhance the mill strategy, and a variety of removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Power Word Kill, the goal is to control the board and keep the opponent on the back foot. The deck also includes card draw spells like Into the Story to maintain card advantage and a companion in Lurrus of the Dream-Den to serve as a late-game value engine.

The deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced gameplay by utilizing creatures with strong attacking abilities and powerful combat tricks. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures like Goldspan Dragon, Lovestruck Beast, and Bonecrusher Giant, supported by spells like Embercleave and The Akroan War. The deck also includes mana-fixing lands like Den of the Bugbear and pathways to ensure smooth mana curve. This deck is designed to apply consistent pressure on the opponent and maintain board presence throughout the game.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly, utilizing efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, while also generating card advantage with Edgewall Innkeeper. The deck aims to go wide with tokens from cards like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Esika's Chariot, then finish off the opponent with powerful equipment like Embercleave. The inclusion of some control elements such as The Akroan War and Shatterskull Smashing helps to clear the way for attacks and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck is all about aggressive plays and overwhelming the opponent with a fast-paced assault.

The deck also includes strong finishers like Embercleave and Goldspan Dragon to close out games. With a mix of creatures, removal, and combat tricks, this deck aims to apply pressure from the beginning and maintain it until victory.
